source_title: Boston AI Week 2026 — The Festival of AI in Massachusetts (official): September 16 – October 28, 2026; core festival week September 24 – October 2; flagship Boston AI Summit on October 1, 2026 at Foundation Medicine, 400 Summer Street, Boston (250 seats, by application)

evidence.observed_facts: Official aiweek.boston page (fetched 2026-08-12) states Boston AI Week 2026, the Festival of AI in Massachusetts, runs September 16 – October 28, 2026 (six weeks, from the Berkshires to Wellfleet), with core festival week September 24 – October 2 and a 2026 goal to double the 2025 figures of 125+ events and 15,000+ participants across 249 participating companies. The flagship Boston AI Summit page (aiweek.boston/summit, fetched 2026-08-12) confirms a single-track summit on Thursday, October 1, 2026, doors 9:00 AM, program 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM, at Foundation Medicine, 400 Summer Street, Boston, 250 seats by application, opening with the release of the State of AI in Massachusetts 2026 report.
evidence.inference: A multi-week statewide AI festival with a flagship summit in Boston indicates heavy AI-community activity through the fall season; this is an awareness flag for Joe, not an elimination and not a date recommendation.
